summary: Mages are cloth-wearing casters who deal Arcane, Fire and Frost damage and control enemies with Polymorph and Frost Nova. They also conjure food, water and mana gems, and open portals between cities.
talent_levels_note: A talent ability can be taken once you can reach its row: the first talent point comes at level 10 and each row needs 5 more points, so row N opens at level 10 + 5 × (N − 1). Talent rows are from wowforevertalent.com; the Forever tooltips of Arcane Blast (20), Arcane Wrath (25), Pyroblast (20), Blast Wave (30), Combustion (40), Ice Block (spellbook level 25 on wowforevertalent.com) and Ice Barrier (40) show the same levels.

abilities.name: Arcane Intellect
abilities.text: Increases the target's Intellect by 2 for 1 hour.
abilities.summary: Increases the target's Intellect by 2 for 1 hour.

abilities.note: Group version of Arcane Intellect; needs Arcane Powder.
abilities.name: Arcane Brilliance
abilities.text: Infuses the target's party and raid with brilliance, increasing their Intellect by 31 for 1 hour.
abilities.summary: Infuses the target's party and raid with brilliance, increasing their Intellect by 31 for 1 hour.

abilities.name: Arcane Missiles
abilities.text: Launches Arcane Missiles at the enemy, causing 25 Arcane damage each second for 3 sec.
abilities.summary: Launches Arcane Missiles at the enemy, causing 25 Arcane damage each second for 3 sec.

abilities.name: Arcane Explosion
abilities.text: Causes an explosion of arcane magic around the caster, causing 32 to 36 Arcane damage to all targets within 10 yards.
abilities.summary: Causes an explosion of arcane magic around the caster, causing 32 to 36 Arcane damage to all targets within 10 yards.

abilities.name: Amplify Magic
abilities.text: Amplifies magic used against the targeted party member, increasing damage taken from spells by up to 23 and healing spells by up to 45. Lasts 10 min.
abilities.summary: Amplifies magic used against the targeted party member, increasing damage taken from spells by up to 23 and healing spells by up to 45.

abilities.name: Dampen Magic
abilities.text: Dampens magic used against the targeted party member, decreasing damage taken from spells by up to 15 and healing spells by up to 30. Lasts 10 min.
abilities.summary: Dampens magic used against the targeted party member, decreasing damage taken from spells by up to 15 and healing spells by up to 30.

abilities.name: Blink
abilities.text: Teleports the caster 20 yards forward, unless something is in the way. Also frees the caster from Stuns and Immobilizes.
abilities.summary: Teleports the caster 20 yards forward, unless something is in the way.

abilities.name: Counterspell
abilities.text: Counters the enemy's spellcast, preventing any spell from that school of magic from being cast for 10 sec. Generates a high amount of threat.
abilities.summary: Counters the enemy's spellcast, preventing any spell from that school of magic from being cast for 10 sec.

abilities.name: Evocation
abilities.text: While channeling this spell, your mana regeneration is active and increased by 1500%. Lasts 8 sec.
abilities.summary: While channeling this spell, your mana regeneration is active and increased by 1500%.

abilities.name: Mage Armor
abilities.text: Increases your resistance to all magic by 5 and allows 50% of your mana regeneration to continue while casting. Only one type of Armor spell can be active on the Mage at any time. Lasts 30 min.
abilities.summary: Increases your resistance to all magic by 5 and allows 50% of your mana regeneration to continue while casting.

abilities.name: Mana Shield
abilities.text: Absorbs 120 physical damage, draining mana instead. Drains 2 mana per damage absorbed. Lasts 1 min.
abilities.summary: Absorbs 120 physical damage, draining mana instead.

abilities.note: Removes a Curse or a Bane (Warlock Banes are new in Forever).
abilities.name: Remove Lesser Curse

abilities.summary: Removes 1 Curse or Bane from a friendly target.

abilities.name: Slow Fall
abilities.text: Slows falling speed for 30 sec.
abilities.summary: Slows falling speed for 30 sec.

abilities.name: Polymorph
abilities.text: Transforms the enemy into a sheep, forcing it to wander around for up to 20 sec. While wandering, the sheep cannot attack or cast spells but will regenerate very quickly. Any damage will transform the target back into its normal form. Only one target can be polymorphed at a time. Only works on Beasts, Humanoids and Critters.

Any damage will transform the target back into its normal form. Only one target can be polymorphed at a time. Only works on Beasts, Humanoids and Critters.
abilities.summary: Transforms the enemy into a pig, forcing it to wander around for up to 50 sec.

abilities.summary: Transforms the enemy into a turtle, forcing it to wander around for up to 50 sec.

abilities.note: New talent spell; each cast raises its own mana cost and your spell damage, stacking.
abilities.name: Arcane Blast
abilities.text: Blasts the target with energy, dealing 34 to 38 Arcane damage. Each time you cast Arcane Blast, you gain 12% of your Intellect as Spell Damage and the mana cost of Arcane Blast is increased by 100%. Effect stacks up to 4 times and lasts 18 sec from time of initial application.
abilities.summary: Blasts the target with energy, dealing 34 to 38 Arcane damage.

abilities.note: New talent spell; needs Arcane Blast at full rank.
abilities.name: Arcane Wrath
abilities.text: Launches a projectile of pure Arcane energy at the enemy target, causing 122 to 146 Arcane damage. This spell gains additional Spell Damage equal to 5% of your maximum Mana.
abilities.summary: Launches a projectile of pure Arcane energy at the enemy target, causing 122 to 146 Arcane damage.

abilities.name: Presence of Mind
abilities.text: When activated, your next Mage spell with a casting time less than 10 sec becomes an instant cast spell.
abilities.summary: When activated, your next Mage spell with a casting time less than 10 sec becomes an instant cast spell.

abilities.name: Arcane Power
abilities.text: For the next 15 sec, your spells deal 30% more damage while costing 30% more mana to cast.
abilities.summary: For the next 15 sec, your spells deal 30% more damage while costing 30% more mana to cast.

abilities.name: Fireball
abilities.text: Hurls a fiery ball that causes 15 to 23 Fire damage and an additional 2 Fire damage over 4 sec.
abilities.summary: Hurls a fiery ball that causes 15 to 23 Fire damage and an additional 2 Fire damage over 4 sec.

abilities.name: Fire Blast
abilities.text: Blasts the enemy for 27 to 35 Fire damage.
abilities.summary: Blasts the enemy for 27 to 35 Fire damage.

abilities.name: Scorch
abilities.text: Scorch the enemy for 38 to 46 Fire damage.
abilities.summary: Scorch the enemy for 38 to 46 Fire damage.

abilities.name: Flamestrike
abilities.text: Calls down a pillar of fire, burning all enemies within the area for 55 to 71 Fire damage and an additional 44 Fire damage over 8 sec. Only one Flamestrike can be active per Mage at a time.
abilities.summary: Calls down a pillar of fire, burning all enemies within the area for 55 to 71 Fire damage and an additional 44 Fire damage over 8 sec.

abilities.name: Fire Ward
abilities.text: Absorbs 162 Fire damage. Lasts 30 sec.
abilities.summary: Absorbs 162 Fire damage.

abilities.note: New Fire and Frost bolt, trained at level 40.
abilities.name: Frostfire Bolt
abilities.text: Launches a bolt of frostfire at the enemy, causing 103 to 118 Frostfire damage, slowing movement speed by 40% and causing an additional 27 Frostfire damage over 9 sec. This spell will be checked against the lower of the target's Frost and Fire resists and counts as both Frost and Fire damage.
abilities.summary: Launches a bolt of frostfire at the enemy, causing 103 to 118 Frostfire damage, slowing movement speed by 40% and causing an additional 27 Frostfire damage over 9 sec.

abilities.name: Pyroblast
abilities.text: Hurls an immense fiery boulder that causes 101 to 131 Fire damage and an additional 44 Fire damage over 12 sec.
abilities.summary: Hurls an immense fiery boulder that causes 101 to 131 Fire damage and an additional 44 Fire damage over 12 sec.

abilities.name: Blast Wave
abilities.text: A wave of flame radiates outward from the caster, damaging all enemies caught within the blast for 154 to 184 Fire damage, and Dazing them for 50% reduced movement speed for 6 sec.
abilities.summary: A wave of flame radiates outward from the caster, damaging all enemies caught within the blast for 154 to 184 Fire damage, and Dazing them for 50% reduced movement speed for 6 sec.

abilities.name: Combustion
abilities.text: When activated, this spell causes each of your Fire damage spell hits to increase your critical strike chance with Fire damage spells by 10%. This effect lasts until you have caused 3 non-periodic critical strikes with Fire spells.
abilities.summary: When activated, this spell causes each of your Fire damage spell hits to increase your critical strike chance with Fire damage spells by 10%.

abilities.name: Frostbolt
abilities.text: Launches a bolt of frost at the enemy, causing 19 to 21 Frost damage and slowing movement speed by 40% for 5 sec.
abilities.summary: Launches a bolt of frost at the enemy, causing 19 to 21 Frost damage and slowing movement speed by 40% for 5 sec.

abilities.name: Frost Nova
abilities.text: Blasts enemies near the caster for 22 to 24 Frost damage and freezes them in place for up to 8 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect.
abilities.summary: Blasts enemies near the caster for 22 to 24 Frost damage and freezes them in place for up to 8 sec.

abilities.name: Frost Armor
abilities.text: Increases Armor by 30. If an enemy strikes the caster, they may have their movement slowed by 30% and the time between their attacks increased by 25% for 5 sec. Only one type of Armor spell can be active on the Mage at any time. Lasts 30 min.
abilities.summary: Increases Armor by 30.

abilities.name: Ice Armor
abilities.text: Increases Armor by 290 and frost resistance by 6. If an enemy strikes the caster, they may have their movement slowed by 30% and the time between their attacks increased by 25% for 5 sec. Only one type of Armor spell can be active on the Mage at any time. Lasts 30 min.
abilities.summary: Increases Armor by 290 and frost resistance by 6.

abilities.name: Blizzard
abilities.text: Ice shards pelt the target area doing (24.5 * 8 * 1) Frost damage over 8 sec.
abilities.summary: Ice shards pelt the target area doing (24.5 * 8 * 1) Frost damage over 8 sec.

abilities.name: Cone of Cold
abilities.text: Targets in a cone in front of the caster take 96 to 106 Frost damage and are slowed by 40% for 6 sec. The first 4 targets hit by this cone are slowed by an additional 10% for an additional 3 sec.
abilities.summary: Targets in a cone in front of the caster take 96 to 106 Frost damage and are slowed by 40% for 6 sec.

abilities.name: Frost Ward
abilities.text: Absorbs 162 Frost damage. Lasts 30 sec.
abilities.summary: Absorbs 162 Frost damage.

abilities.note: New talent spell. Wowhead also lists spell 400640 (Ice Lance, level 28, not a talent), which looks like a later rank.
abilities.name: Ice Lance
abilities.text: Deals 28 to 32 Frost damage to an enemy target. Deals 300% increased damage to Frozen targets.
abilities.summary: Deals 28 to 32 Frost damage to an enemy target.

abilities.name: Ice Block
abilities.text: You become encased in a block of ice, protecting you from all physical attacks and spells for 10 sec, but during that time you cannot attack, move, or cast spells.
abilities.summary: You become encased in a block of ice, protecting you from all physical attacks and spells for 10 sec, but during that time you cannot attack, move, or cast spells.

abilities.name: Cold Snap
abilities.text: Finishes the remaining cooldown on all your other Frost spells.
abilities.summary: Finishes the remaining cooldown on all your other Frost spells.

abilities.name: Ice Barrier
abilities.text: Shield yourself, absorbing 448 damage and increasing your Frost damage by 15% for 1 min. While shielded, your Frost damage is increased by an additional 5% and you do not lose casting time when you take damage.
abilities.summary: Shield yourself, absorbing 448 damage and increasing your Frost damage by 15% for 1 min.

abilities.note: Part of the new scroll research system: deciphers an untranslated scroll.
abilities.name: Comprehend Scroll
abilities.text: Decipher an untranslated scroll.
abilities.summary: Decipher an untranslated scroll.

abilities.note: Researches spells at a library to produce scrolls. Listed on Wowhead; not shown on wowforevertalent.com.
abilities.name: Study
abilities.text: Perform spell research, resulting in a bundle of scrolls. Requires a suitable library.
abilities.summary: Perform spell research, resulting in a bundle of scrolls.

passive_talents.note: New: Arcane Blast and other bolts shorten your next Arcane Missiles.
passive_talents.name: Missile Barrage
passive_talents.text: Gives your Arcane Blast spell a 40% chance, and your Arcane Wrath, Fireball, Frostbolt, and Frostfire Bolt spells a 20% chance to reduce the channeled duration of your next Arcane Missiles spell by 50%, reduce the Mana cost by 100%, and missiles fire every 0.5 sec.
passive_talents.summary: Gives your Arcane Blast spell a 40% chance, and your Arcane Wrath, Fireball, Frostbolt, and Frostfire Bolt spells a 20% chance to reduce the channeled duration of your next Arcane Missiles spell by 50%, reduce the Mana cost by 100%, and missiles fire every 0.5 sec.

passive_talents.note: New (Hotstreak on fan guides): critical strikes cut the cast time of your next Pyroblast.
passive_talents.name: Heating Up
passive_talents.text: Non-periodic critical strikes with Fireball, Frostfire Bolt, Fire Blast, and Scorch reduce the cast time of your next Pyroblast cast within 20 sec by 25%, stacking up to 3 times. Fire Blast grants an additional stack every time it deals damage.
passive_talents.summary: Non-periodic critical strikes with Fireball, Frostfire Bolt, Fire Blast, and Scorch reduce the cast time of your next Pyroblast cast within 20 sec by 25%, stacking up to 3 times.

passive_talents.note: New: Chill effects can make your next two spells treat the target as Frozen.
passive_talents.name: Fingers of Frost
passive_talents.text: Gives your Chill effects a 15% chance to grant you the Fingers of Frost effect, which treats your next 2 spells cast as if the target were Frozen. Lasts 15 sec.
passive_talents.summary: Gives your Chill effects a 15% chance to grant you the Fingers of Frost effect, which treats your next 2 spells cast as if the target were Frozen.

changes: New talent abilities: Arcane Blast and Arcane Wrath (Arcane) and Ice Lance (Frost).
New trained spells: Frostfire Bolt (level 40) and Teleport: Dalaran (level 50).
New passive talents: Missile Barrage and Arcane Geometry (Arcane), Heating Up (Fire) and Fingers of Frost (Frost).
New scroll research spells (Comprehend Scroll, Study).
Remove Lesser Curse also removes Banes.
Ice Block, Cold Snap and Ice Barrier keep their Classic talent form, but Ice Block moves to row 4, Cold Snap to row 5, and Ice Barrier now needs Cold Snap.
Blast Wave no longer requires Pyroblast; Arcane Power now requires Presence of Mind.
